defs.def: a plant that is grown in large quantities, especially as food 庄稼；作物

ex.s: Diets have changed in China – and so too has its top crop.
They are experimenting with growing crops in space so as (help) astronauts get enough food on longer journeys through space.
ex.t: 他们正在试验在太空中种植庄稼，以帮助宇航员在更长的太空旅程中获得足够的食物。

defs.def: the amount of grain, fruit, etc. that is grown in one season （谷物、水果等一季的）收成，产量
a group of people who do sth at the same time; a number of things that happen at the same time （同时做某事的）一群人，一批人；（同时发生的）一些事情
a short whip used by horse riders （骑手的）短马鞭
a very short hairstyle 短发
hair that is short and thick 短而密的头发
a part of a bird's throat shaped like a bag where food is stored before it passes into the stomach 嗉囊；嗉子
to cut sb's hair very short 剪短
to cut off part of a photograph or picture 剪裁（照片或图画）
to bite off and eat the tops of plants, especially grass 啃吃（青草或其他植物上面的部分）
to produce a crop 植物
to use land to grow crops 种地；种庄稼

ex.s: Machines have largely taken over planting, watering and harvesting crops such as com and wheat, but the monitoring of cattle has gone through fewer changes.
ex.t: 对德克萨斯州养牛人皮特·邦兹来说，越来越难以找到愿意照看牛的工人。

ex.s: Over thousands of years，they began to depend less on ___57___ could be hunted or gathered from the wild，and more on animals they had raised and crops they had sown.
ex.t: 农业比狩猎和采集每人生产更多的食物   ___58___ 所以人们能够抚养更多的孩子。

ex.s: By about 6000 BC，people ___61___ (discover)the best crops to grow and animals to raise.
ex.t: 这种农耕方式持续了相当长的时间。

ex.s: Without the glaciers, water will arrive in the rivers at times when it can damage crops.
ex.t: 如果没有冰川，水会在破坏农作物的时期流入河流。

ex.s: Over five generations the land has been too wet for cropping.
ex.t: 经过五代人的时间，这片土地一直太潮湿无法种植作物。

ex.s: But during the past decade declining rainfall has allowed him to plant highly profitable crops.
ex.t: 但在过去十年里，降雨量的减少使他能够种植高利润的作物。

ex.s: adapt to carbon pollutionB. plant highly profitable crops
ex.t: 适应碳污染B. 种植高利润作物

ex.s: They could grow crops in these areas.
ex.t: 他们可以在这些地区种植庄稼。

ex.s: Scientists hope to learn more about this plant warning system, so that we can use it to grow crops without pesticides.
ex.t: 科学家希望更多地了解这种植物预警系统，以便我们能够利用它在不施用农药的情况下种植庄稼。

ex.s: Animals that live on the crops 7____________.
This important agricultural festival takes place after all the crops have been gathered in.
ex.t: 这个重要的农业节日在所有庄稼收割完毕后举行。
